QPointer<ads::CAutoHideDockContainer>
local VERDICT = {
	USABLE = 0,
	UNUSABLE = 2,
	MALFORMED = 3,
	TOO_LARGE = 5,
local CAPS = {
	model = { entities = 2048, bytes = 4194304 },
	accessory = { entities = 64, bytes = 262144 },
local LINK_PREFIX = "https://luduvo.com/"
local SLOT_COUNT = engine and engine.accessory_slot_count
assert(type(SLOT_COUNT) == "number",
	"the host must set engine.accessory_slot_count")
local ALLOWED_COMPONENTS = {
	Position = true,
	Rotation = true,
	Scale = true,
	Name = true,
	Mesh = true,
	SurfaceAppearance = true,
	Attachment = true,
	LocalTransform = true,
	Billboard = true,
	BillboardOnTop = true,
	Light = true,
	SpotCone = true,
	LightShadowOff = true,
local ALLOWED_CHUNKS = {
	CK_TYPES = true,
	CK_TREE = true,
	CK_COMP = true,
	CK_CCSCHEMA = true,
	CK_PLATFORM = true,
	CK_NAMES = true,
local function named(name, fallback)
	if name == "" then
		return fallback
	return name
local function screen(item_type, head)
	if head.byte_len == 0 then
		return {
			verdict = VERDICT.MALFORMED,
			reason = "the file has no bytes",
	local caps = CAPS[item_type]
	if caps and head.byte_len > caps.bytes then
		return {
			verdict = VERDICT.TOO_LARGE,
			reason = string.format(
				"the file is %d bytes, the %s limit is %d " ..
				"bytes", head.byte_len, item_type, caps.bytes),
	if head.format_version < head.format_min or
	   head.format_version > head.format_max then
		return {
			verdict = VERDICT.MALFORMED,
			reason = string.format(
				"the file declares scene format %d, this " ..
				"build reads %d-%d", head.format_version,
				head.format_min, head.format_max),
	if head.declared_expanded > head.expanded_cap then
		return {
			verdict = VERDICT.TOO_LARGE,
			reason = string.format(
				"the file expands to %s bytes, the limit " ..
				"is %d bytes", head.declared_expanded_text,
				head.expanded_cap),
	if item_type == "accessory" then
		if not head.chunks_readable then
			return {
				verdict = VERDICT.MALFORMED,
				reason = "the chunk container does not open",
		for _, chunk in ipairs(head.chunks) do
			if not ALLOWED_CHUNKS[chunk.name] then
				return {
					verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
					reason = string.format(
						"the file holds a %s chunk, " ..
						"which an accessory must " ..
						"not hold", chunk.name),
	return nil
local function judge_accessory(facts)
	if facts.root_count ~= 1 then
		return {
			verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
			reason = string.format(
				"the file holds %d scene roots, an " ..
				"accessory holds one", facts.root_count),
	local root = facts.ents[facts.first_root]
	local a = root.attachment
	if a == nil or not a.root then
		return {
			verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
			reason = string.format(
				"the root '%.48s' has no root Attachment",
				root.name),
	if a.slot >= SLOT_COUNT then
		return {
			verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
			reason = string.format(
				"the root Attachment names slot %d, the " ..
				"platform has %d slots", a.slot, SLOT_COUNT),
	local slot = a.slot
	for i, ent in ipairs(facts.ents) do
		if i ~= facts.first_root and ent.attachment ~= nil and
		   ent.attachment.root then
			return {
				verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
				reason = string.format(
					"the child '%.48s' holds a second " ..
					"root Attachment", ent.name),
				slot = slot,
	for _, ent in ipairs(facts.ents) do
		if ent.script then
			return {
				verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
				reason = string.format(
					"the entity '%.48s' holds a " ..
					"script, and an accessory runs no " ..
					"code", ent.name),
				slot = slot,
	for _, ent in ipairs(facts.ents) do
		for _, comp in ipairs(ent.components) do
			if not ALLOWED_COMPONENTS[comp.name] then
				return {
					verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
					reason = string.format(
						"the entity '%.32s' holds " ..
						"%.32s (tid %d), which an " ..
						"accessory must not hold",
						ent.name,
						named(comp.name,
						      "a component"),
						comp.tid),
					slot = slot,
		for _, unknown in ipairs(ent.unknown) do
			return {
				verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
				reason = string.format(
					"the entity '%.32s' holds %.32s, " ..
					"which the loader does not stamp " ..
					"and an accessory must not hold",
					ent.name,
					named(unknown, "an unnamed id")),
				slot = slot,
		for _, pair in ipairs(ent.pairs) do
			return {
				verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
				reason = string.format(
					"the entity '%.32s' holds a %.32s " ..
					"pair, which an accessory must not " ..
					"hold", ent.name,
					named(pair, "an unnamed")),
				slot = slot,
	return {
		verdict = VERDICT.USABLE,
		slot = slot,
		spec = { slot = slot, parts = facts.parts },
local function judge_model(facts)
	if facts.root_count ~= 1 then
		return {
			verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
			reason = string.format(
				"the file holds %d scene roots, a model " ..
				"holds one", facts.root_count),
	if facts.holds_core_menu_action then
		return {
			verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
			reason = "the model holds a core menu component, " ..
				"and the platform owns the core Menu",
	return { verdict = VERDICT.USABLE }
local function judge_place(facts)
	local place = facts.place
	if place.menus > place.core_menu_count then
		return {
			verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
			reason = string.format(
				"the place holds %d core Menus, and a " ..
				"place holds at most %d; delete every " ..
				"Menu but one", place.menus,
				place.core_menu_count),
	if place.drawn_nodes > place.node_budget then
		return {
			verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
			reason = string.format(
				"the place draws %d screen nodes, and a " ..
				"place gets %d of the %d the client draws, " ..
				"because the platform Menu takes the rest",
				place.drawn_nodes, place.node_budget,
				place.tree_max_nodes),
	if place.menu_too_deep then
		return {
			verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
			reason = string.format(
				"the core Menu nests more than %d levels " ..
				"below its root, and the client walks %d, " ..
				"so its panels never open",
				place.menu_max_depth, place.menu_max_depth),
	return { verdict = VERDICT.USABLE }
local function judge(item_type, facts)
	if not facts.loaded then
		return {
			verdict = VERDICT.MALFORMED,
			reason = "the loader refused the file, the log " ..
				"names the chunk",
	local caps = CAPS[item_type]
	if caps and facts.entities > caps.entities then
		return {
			verdict = VERDICT.TOO_LARGE,
			reason = string.format(
				"the file expands to %d entities, the %s " ..
				"limit is %d entities", facts.entities,
				item_type, caps.entities),
	local bad = facts.nonfinite
	if bad ~= nil then
		local reason
		if bad.singleton then
			reason = string.format(
				"the singleton %.32s holds %.32s, which " ..
				"is not a finite number", bad.component,
				bad.field)
			reason = string.format(
				"the entity '%.24s' holds %.24s.%.24s, " ..
				"which is not a finite number", bad.entity,
				bad.component, bad.field)
		return { verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE, reason = reason }
	for _, link in ipairs(facts.links) do
		local head = string.lower(string.sub(link, 1, #LINK_PREFIX))
		if head ~= LINK_PREFIX then
			return {
				verdict = VERDICT.UNUSABLE,
				reason = string.format(
					"the link '%.48s' leaves luduvo.com, " ..
					"and a game opens only addresses that " ..
					"start with %s", link, LINK_PREFIX),
	if item_type == "accessory" then
		return judge_accessory(facts)
	if item_type == "model" then
		return judge_model(facts)
	return judge_place(facts)
return {
	version = 8,
	min_accepted = 1,
	accessory_max_bytes = CAPS.accessory.bytes,
	screen = screen,
	judge = judge,

void main()
    vec2 tcoord;
    vec3 yuv, rgb;
    // Get the Y value 
    tcoord = v_texCoord;
    yuv.x = texture2D(tex0, tcoord).r;
    // Get the U and V values 
    tcoord *= UVCoordScale;
    yuv.yz = texture2D(tex1, tcoord).gr;
    // Do the color transform 
    yuv += Yoffset;
    rgb.r = dot(yuv, Rcoeff);
    rgb.g = dot(yuv, Gcoeff);
    rgb.b = dot(yuv, Bcoeff);
    // That was easy. :) 
    gl_FragColor = vec4(rgb, 1.0) * v_color;
